columns.name: MILESTONE_ID
columns.description: Milestone identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MILESTONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Milestone number as generated by the system.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of lease in which the milestone was added.

columns.name: MILESTONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Milestone type as defined by the user.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the milestone as entered by the user.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source for the milestone. Sources can be Lease, Payment, Option or Asset.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Source identifier for the milestone. Values could be lease number, asset number, payment number or option number.

columns.name: MILESTONE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Milestone status. Various statuses can be Open, Completed and Cancelled.

columns.name: NOTICE_DATE
columns.description: Notice date as recorded for the milestone.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Notification frequency. Values could be One-Time, Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly.

columns.name: LAST_NOTIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date the last notification was sent by the system.

columns.name: ACTION_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Action due date as recorded for the milestone.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO_USER_NAME
columns.description: User to whom the milestone is assigned.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
